newsitem.title: USA: Sunstone to buy $200 million in hotel assets in '97.
newsitem.headline: Sunstone to buy $200 million in hotel assets in '97.

text.p: Sunstone Hotel Investors Inc., a real estate investment trust, said Tuesday it plans to buy $200 million worth of U.S. hotel assets in 1997 and reported a 155 percent increase in first-quarter profits to $3.4 million.
In addition to the planned acquisitions, Sunstone said it would spend $18 million to renovate its properties this year.

Sunstone's net income, equivalent to 23 cents a share, compared with earnings of $1.3 million, or 21 cents a share, in the first quarter of 1996. It fell below the consensus Wall Street analyst forecast of 31 cents a share, according to First Call, which tracks analyst predictions.
Sunstone recorded $7.8 million in revenue vs. $3.2 million in the year-ago period.
The San Clemente, Calif.-based company specialises in Western mid-level and upscale hotels.
Its stock was unchanged at $13.50 in consolidated early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
